## 3 · Theory (22')

**Read:** example book §1.

A linear combination is $\sum_{i=1}^n \alpha_i v_i$ with $\alpha_i \in \mathbb R$. In display:
$$\operatorname{span}(v_1, \dots, v_n) = \Big\{ \sum_i \alpha_i v_i : \alpha \in \mathbb R^n \Big\}.$$
